tracks.title: Hook
tracks.text: My daughter was diagnosed eight years ago and I still remember the day that Family Reach paid our mortgage.

tracks.title: Who She Is
tracks.text: So I currently have five children. Prior to our cancer diagnosis, we had just my older son, and Paisley, who’s my cancer patient. And she was three when she was diagnosed, I was a full-time working mom. as soon as the cancer diagnosis hit, I quit my job entirely. Our entire world’s flipped upside down,

tracks.title: The Call
tracks.text: So I had brought Paisley into her pediatrician just for what I thought was some sort of illness, They did some blood work, and one of the pediatricians called me later that day Her blood work’s coming back, and it’s not coming good.

tracks.title: No One Said Cancer
tracks.text: She was telling me that her platelets were low. I was calling them plates and pallets to my mom and family and friends. I wasn’t understanding what was happening at all. Never was the word cancer mentioned to me at any point.

tracks.title: 11 O’Clock At Night
tracks.text: It wasn’t until 11 o’clock at night that they rolled us up to the bone marrow transplant unit that I was like, oh, wow, you guys think it’s cancer.

tracks.title: My Fault
tracks.text: They gave us a diagnosis, and I think I just broke down and honestly can barely remember half of it because I think I just cried for hours straight thinking that it was my fault, something that I did or some environment that I put her in that I know now is not the case.

tracks.title: 44 Days
tracks.text: Like I said, she was in the hospital for 44 days. I couldn’t even physically leave the hospital to do anything to get any money.

tracks.title: Family Reach
tracks.text: I was approached by the social workers at the hospital with some resource information to help pay for our mortgage and car payment while I was in the hospital and not able to work and family reach was brought up.

tracks.title: The Mortgage
tracks.text: Right off the bat, I remember Family Reach paid a mortgage payment for us that was just one month that we didn’t have to stress about how we were going to pay our mortgage payment. That’s the most standout moment that they’ve ever provided for us.

tracks.beat: IT SHOULD NOT BE ON THE FAMILY
tracks.title: It Should Not Be On The Family
tracks.text: A lot of hospitals, you’re chasing down the social workers to get that information. And I just don’t think that that’s something that should be put on the patient and their family, especially when the patient’s so young it’s a lot of stress that the families don’t need to have when they’re already worried about their child making it to the next day

tracks.title: When We Needed It
tracks.text: Family Reach helped us when we needed it the most.

tracks.title: Paisley Today
tracks.text: My daughter is thriving. She’s a typical 11 year old girl plays lacrosse year-round and loves playing with her friends.

tracks.title: She Doesn’T Remember
tracks.text: She doesn’t even remember her cancer treatment, which again I’m forever grateful for.
